answers.reason: The senate handles central university matters, whereas the student representative is elected only at the faculty level and members only participate in one body.
Budget planning is a central financial matter, outside the student representative's specific teaching and study domain.
Appointments of professors are separate from student representation in teaching matters, and members only sit in one body.
Although the student representative is elected at the faculty level, each body handles one delimited question and student matters regarding degree programmes belong in the study commission.
As the elected voice for faculty students, the representative's single designated place to participate is the commission that prepares changes to degree programmes and advises on teaching.
The examination board handles administrative examination cases of individual students, which is separate from general student representation in study programmes.
Research funding does not concern the students' matters, and members do not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
Rewriting module descriptions is a specialized working group task, while the elected representative participates in only one body.
Equipment procurement is strictly separated from study programme matters, so the student representative does not take part.
Planning the orientation week is a specific operational task for ordinary students, whereas the elected representative only sits in one formal committee.
